title: Abba Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: The home and the setting were wonderful! We\'ve stayed in other luxury beach accommodations, but none measure up to Abba Cottage. From the high-end finishes in the house to the ocean views and the surrounding area, it was a magical experience. The entire house appears to be recently updated. The beds were extremely comfortable, the bathrooms were perfect, and the kitchen was amazing! The main living area, the primary bedroom and both porches provide great views of the ocean over the Eastern green. There are plenty of big screen TV\'s for the few times we weren\'t taking in the scenery or strolling the neighborhood. We were even allowed to park our car in the garage. The town square with great stores and restaurants is an easy walk from the house. A large variety of other great restaurants are a short drive away. While the pictures of the house look enticing, they don\'t do it justice. It exceeded our expectations! We will definitely try to book Abba Cottage again.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
